project: A Three-Graph with Transcendental Turan Density

scope.conclusion: There exists a finite simple 3-uniform hypergraph with a nonempty edge set and transcendental ordinary Turan density over Q.
scope.containment: Globally injective vertex maps preserving edges, including all isolated forbidden vertices.
scope.density: Ordinary binomial-normalized extremal density; the infimum definition is proved to equal its asymptotic limit.
scope.source_upper_and_lower_inequalities: Both proved and assembled without extra host or realization assumptions.

all_source_lake_build.scope_note: Genuine dependency-validated Lake builds/replays, allowing valid cached artifacts; not a claim of a fresh zero-cache rebuild.

default_lake_build.job_count_note: Lake jobs include dependencies and replayed artifacts; this is not a count of local source files freshly elaborated in this pass.

source_integrity.token_scan_note: Supplementary textual check using nested-comment stripping and token boundaries; the transitive axiom audit supplies the semantic dependency check for the listed declarations.

executable_constructor.scope_note: Compilation checks the regular constructor and executable dependency chain. The huge enabled computation was not run. The axiom audit includes proof fields; its standard classical axioms do not constitute a noncomputable runtime data path.

initial_attempt.failure_message: bwrap: loopback: Failed to create NETLINK_ROUTE socket: Operation not permitted
initial_attempt.failure_stage: Preparing the sandbox to build Challenge, before independent statement comparison and external-kernel replay.

compatibility_recheck.note: Historical strict combined invocation: comparison and mandatory Lean/NanoDa accepted, but the whole command failed for con-ron exit 137. A later independently recorded mandatory-only replay exited zero, and the authenticated advisory replay received a recognized fuel-exhausted decline with passing controls.

mandatory_replay.export_provenance: Generated by the original pinned bundled exporter inside the earlier full source-build Comparator invocation. Same bytes retained and hashed; no proof or export edits. This run replays those exports rather than rebuilding sources.

public_palomar_full_preflight.note: The pinned workflow is present. An actual public run on a specified repository commit, registry review, and acceptance are separate outstanding steps.

independent_human_mathematical_review.note: Development used AI assistance. The local kernel checks do not constitute an independent human review of the source-to-formalization correspondence.

metadata_validator.scope: Pinned official metadata contract, not a full public preflight.

advisory_con_ron.scope: A genuine fuel-exhausted diagnostic, classified by the exact pinned official function after both controls passed. This is not con-ron acceptance and does not retrospectively classify the earlier exit 137.

mandatory_controls.scope: Mandatory Lean default and NanoDa small control portion of the pinned Palomar comparator preflight, run locally with preserved isolation.
mandatory_controls.nanoda_negative_control_note: NanoDa refuses the ill-typed export by a type-equality assertion panic (src/tc.rs:955), exiting 101. Lean default also rejects. The authenticated pinned classifier returns comparator.rejected. Raw stderr is retained without suppression.

attempts.reason: The outer private /run filesystem lacked /run/user, so the nested read-only-root sandbox could not create that mask mount point. All four compilation/export phases had succeeded.

attempts.infrastructure_change: Create an empty /run/user directory inside the already-private outer /run tmpfs. No mask, namespace restriction, read-only root, environment clearing, lifecycle option, or capability drop was removed. The frozen adapter was not changed.

evidence_layout.logs: Each attempt preserves real compile/judge stdout and stderr; commands and exit codes are in its result.json.
evidence_layout.exports: Raw exporter stdout is preserved as five *.export files per attempt. In attempt-1 only, the export *.stdout.log files are explicitly labeled location notes, not raw transcript streams.
evidence_layout.driver: run-controls.py is the successful reproducible driver; attempt-1/driver-source.py preserves the original driver for the failed infrastructure attempt.

reproduction.preserve_original_evidence: Write rerun output to new files or directories. Do not overwrite the original failed Comparator log or the retained release logs.
